newsitem.title: USA: Data changes name and Nasdaq symbol.
newsitem.headline: Data changes name and Nasdaq symbol.

text.p: Data Translation Inc said on Tuesday it changed its name to Media 100 Inc and will use as its Nasdaq ticker symbol from December 3.

The company said the name change was made in connection with the effectiveness of the spinoff of its data acquisition and imaging and commercial products businesses to its wholly owned subsidiary Data Translation II Inc (New DTI).
The company also attributed the name change to the distribution of New DTI shares to its stockholders.
New DTI changed its name to Data Translation Inc and will assume as its Nasdaq ticker symbol.
